## Use Commit Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Commit Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Commit Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

## About the Commit Mono coding font

A font optimized for Git commits. Commit Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Commit Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Commit Mono FAQ

### Is Commit Mono free?

Yes. Commit Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Commit Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Commit Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Commit Mono?

Commit Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
